subtitle: Reasoning layer hallucinates defeat and throws
synopsis: GPT-4o-mini RC stays in the fight, but after GPT-5 Mini's last recovery swing it reaches the end of turn 20 at 20 HP and produces an invalid 'game over' action. The failure is not just weaker play; the reasoning layer literally talks itself into a forfeit.

highlights.label: Last GPT-5 Mini potion flips it back
Forced into a panic heal and still behind
Still alive at 20 HP before the forfeit
